table.name: matches
table.purpose: One row per completed singles match (women's professional tennis, WTA tour, 2013-2017), recording the tournament, round, surface, score, and attributes of the winner and loser (age, hand, height, player id, country, name, WTA rank, ranking points, seed).

col_001.name: tour_level
col_001.description: Constant value 3 in all rows; likely a code identifying the tour/level of the matches (e.g. WTA main tour). No other value appears, so the exact meaning of '3' cannot be confirmed.

col_002.name: draw_size
col_002.description: Size of the tournament draw: values 4, 8, 12, 16, 32, 64, 128, matching standard tennis draw sizes.

col_003.name: winner_age
col_003.description: Age of the winning player in years (range ~21-37, fractional values typical of age-at-match calculations).

col_005.name: winner_hand
col_005.description: Playing hand of the winner: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

col_006.name: winner_height
col_006.description: Height of the winning player in centimetres (range 157-185).

col_007.name: winner_player_id
col_007.description: Identifier of the winning player; references players.col_001 (many-to-one).

col_008.name: winner_country
col_008.description: Three-letter country/IOC code of the winner's nationality (RUS, CZE, USA, ESP, GER, ...).

col_009.name: winner_name
col_009.description: Full name of the winning player (e.g. Svetlana Kuznetsova, Angelique Kerber).

col_010.name: winner_rank
col_010.description: World ranking of the winner at the time of the match (1-112, mostly low numbers).

col_011.name: winner_rank_points
col_011.description: Ranking points of the winner at the time of the match (544-9945).

col_012.name: winner_seed
col_012.description: Seed of the winner in the tournament draw (1-32; 1-16 typical for big draws).

col_013.name: winner_wta_rank
col_013.description: Value capped at 300 with most rows near 294-300; plausibly an alternative/secondary ranking of the winner (e.g. WTA ranking capped at 300). The cap pattern fits a ranking, but the exact ranking system is unconfirmed.

col_015.name: round
col_015.description: Round of the match: F = final, SF = semi-final, QF = quarter-final, R16/R32 = round of 16/32, RR = round robin.

col_016.name: score
col_016.description: Match score in sets, e.g. '6-4 6-4', '6-4 6-7(4) 6-1' (tie-break scores in parentheses), from the winner's perspective.

col_017.name: surface
col_017.description: Court surface of the match: Hard, Clay, or Grass.

col_018.name: match_date
col_018.description: Date of the match as an integer in YYYYMMDD format (20131021-20170828).

col_019.name: tournament_id
col_019.description: Tournament identifier code, format varies by year (e.g. '2016-M024', '2017-M006', '2013-W-WT-TUR-01A-2013'); groups matches belonging to the same tournament edition.

col_020.name: tournament_tier
col_020.description: Tournament tier/category code: I (International), P (Premier), G (Grand Slam), W (year-end Championships/WTA Finals) is the most common WTA reading, but the exact code meanings are not directly evidenced.

col_021.name: tournament_name
col_021.description: Name of the tournament/city (Indian Wells, Us Open, Miami, Wimbledon, Singapore, ...).

col_022.name: loser_age
col_022.description: Age of the losing player in years (range ~21-37, fractional).

col_024.name: loser_hand
col_024.description: Playing hand of the loser: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

col_025.name: loser_height
col_025.description: Height of the losing player in centimetres (range 159-185).

col_026.name: loser_player_id
col_026.description: Identifier of the losing player; references players.col_001 (many-to-one).

col_027.name: loser_country
col_027.description: Three-letter country/IOC code of the loser's nationality (USA, RUS, CZE, ROU, GER, ...).

col_028.name: loser_name
col_028.description: Full name of the losing player (e.g. Angelique Kerber, Simona Halep).

col_029.name: loser_rank
col_029.description: World ranking of the loser at the time of the match (1-82).

col_030.name: loser_rank_points
col_030.description: Ranking points of the loser at the time of the match (845-12040).

col_031.name: loser_seed
col_031.description: Seed of the loser in the tournament draw (1-30).

table.name: players
table.purpose: Registry of tennis players: one row per player with an ID, first and last name, playing hand, birth date, and country code. Referenced by the matches table (winner/loser player IDs).

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric player identifier. Referenced by matches.col_007 and matches.col_026 (the two player IDs per match, e.g. winner and loser).

col_002.name: first_name
col_002.description: Player's given (first) name(s), e.g. 'Maria Jose', 'Caroline'. Not unique.

col_003.name: last_name
col_003.description: Player's surname/family name, sometimes compound ('Van Renterghem', 'Delgado Valero').

col_004.name: hand
col_004.description: Playing hand code: 'R' = right-handed, 'L' = left-handed, 'U' = unknown/undocumented, empty = missing. Matches the per-match winner/loser hand attributes in the matches table, which use the same code set. The exact distinction between 'U' and empty remains tentative: both plausibly mean 'unknown', with 'U' an explicit code and empty a missing value.

col_005.name: birth_date
col_005.description: Date of birth stored as YYYYMMDD (e.g. 19970313 = 1997-03-13); empty string when unknown. Declared as a union type, so some rows may hold it as integer or text.

col_006.name: country_code
col_006.description: Three-letter country/representation code (IOC-style): USA, ITA, ESP, GER, JPN, BEL, RUS, etc. Historical codes like FRG (West Germany) and ECA appear.

table.name: rankings
table.purpose: ATP/tennis world rankings snapshots: for each weekly ranking date, one row per ranked player giving their rank position, ranking points, and number of tournaments counted. (Matches the well-known ATP rankings dataset alongside 'matches' and 'players' tables.)

col_001.name: ranking_date
col_001.description: Date of the ranking snapshot, encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20160307 = 2016-03-07). Range 1987-07-19 to 2017-09-11; ~1500 weekly snapshots, each with ~1300+ ranked players.

col_002.name: rank
col_002.description: Player's world ranking position on that date (1 = top ranked). Max 1507, consistent with number of ranked players per snapshot.

col_003.name: player_id
col_003.description: Identifier of the ranked player; joins to the players table. Stored as text despite numeric-looking values (e.g. '201305', '211996').

col_004.name: points
col_004.description: Player's ranking points on that date. Highly skewed (median 44, max 13615), consistent with ATP ranking points distribution.

col_005.name: tours
col_005.description: Number of tournaments counted toward the player's ranking points in the rolling window (0-41).
